resumeText:
Jordan Taylor
Full Stack Web Developer
Email: jtaylor@example.com | Portfolio: jordantaylor.dev

SUMMARY
Experienced Full Stack Developer with 5 years crafting performant web applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js. Passionate about frontend architecture, responsive UI, and state management.

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3
Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM
Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Jest, Cypress, Vite, Webpack

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Frontend Engineer | WebFlow Innovations | 2022 - Present

- Migrated legacy JavaScript codebase to strict TypeScript, eliminating runtime type errors.
- Developed GraphQL client integrations using Apollo Client to consume third-party SaaS APIs.
- Improved core web vitals and bundle load speed by 35% through lazy loading and code splitting.

Full Stack Developer | Nexa Digital | 2019 - 2022
- Developed RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma.
- Implemented user authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and session management.
